John Keats, Poetry.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/john-keats/poetry

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- John Keats, the author, died 1821.

First publication of the text used: between 1816 and 1820 (SE colophon: 'Poetry was compiled from poetry published between 1816 and 1820 by John Keats.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition's rights statement (quoted below) says the text is in the US public domain. The text was first published between 1816 and 1820, so the 95-year US term from the latest first publication ended by 1 January 1916.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. Every person named above died in 1821 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever that country is.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: Poetry was compiled from poetry published between 1816 and 1820 by John Keats.
- Wikidata Q82083 (John Keats), P570 = 1821-02-23; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Keats
